questions_and_answers.question: A decrease in business taxes would lead to an increase in national income by increasing which of the following? A. The money supply B. Unemployment C. Aggregate demand only D. Aggregate supply only E. Both aggregate demand and aggregate supply
questions_and_answers.answer: Final Answer: A decrease in business taxes would lead to an **increase **in national income by increasing aggregate demand only. ; Explanation: A decrease in business taxes would lead to an increase in national income by increasing aggregate demand only. Lower taxes mean businesses have more **disposable **income, which they can spend on hiring more workers and purchasing more goods and services. This increase in spending creates a ripple effect, leading to higher incomes and a boost in overall economic activity. Learn more about aggregate demand here: https://brainly.com/question/34781298 #SPJ11 ;

questions_and_answers.question: Which of the following will result in a decrease in Aggregate Demand? A. An increase in government spending. B. A decrease in income tax rates. C. A decrease in domestic interest rates. D. A decrease in the value of the domestic currency relative to the foreign currency. E. An increase in the value of the domestic currency relative to the foreign currency.
questions_and_answers.answer: The following will result in a decrease in aggregate demand: E) An increase in the value of the domestic currency relative to the foreign currency. Foreign currencies fluctuate in value depending on bilateral trade. When the domestic currency's value increases, the other country finds it more expensive to import local goods. Since aggregate demand entails the net exports, it declines. A decrease in government spending contracts the aggregate demand and is vital for slowing rampant inflation. However, increasing it has a vice-versa effect. A decrease in income tax rates increases the disposable incomes available for household expenditures, raising the aggregate demand. A decrease in domestic interest rates discourages savings in favor of spending and investment, effectively expanding the aggregate demand.

list.title: Increased Aggregate Demand:
list.snippet: When businesses have lower tax burdens, they have more after-tax profits, which encourages them to invest and produce more goods and services. This increased production creates a higher demand for inputs like labor and raw materials, further stimulating the economy.

list.title: Increased Aggregate Supply:
list.snippet: Lower taxes can also incentivize businesses to expand their production capacity, leading to a greater ability to supply goods and services at various price levels. This increase in supply capacity contributes to higher national income.

list.title: Tax reduction impact:
list.snippet: By lowering the cost of doing business, taxes can encourage investment, production, and employment, ultimately leading to higher national income.

list.title: Aggregate demand and supply relationship:
list.snippet: Both aggregate demand and aggregate supply are crucial factors determining national income, and a decrease in business taxes can positively influence both.
